column1: # tts-lab voice recording script. Columns: id <TAB> section <TAB> text.
# {shown|arpabet} marks a word whose pronunciation is given explicitly (the
# recorder shows "shown"; ttslab and the aligner use the phones). *word* is
# emphasis: say that word with contrastive stress.
# Section R (read sentences) comes from CMU ARCTIC: tools/fetch-arctic.sh.

column3: (Stay silent for three seconds: this measures the room noise.)
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

column1: # V: sustained vowels. About three seconds each, at a comfortable, steady pitch.

column3: Hold {aw|ao1}, as in "law" (if it sounds the same as "father" to you, that's fine).

column1: # H: vowels in h_d words, in a carrier sentence. Read naturally, not slowly.
# C: b, d, g before six vowels (how the vowel's formants start after each consonant).
# A: every consonant between two "ah" vowels, stress on the second.

column3: Say {ah-THAH|aa0 th aa1} again (th as in "thin").
Say {ah-THAH|aa0 dh aa1} again (th as in "this").
Say {ah-ZHAH|aa0 zh aa1} again (zh as in "measure").
Say {AHNG-ah|aa1 ng aa0} again (ng as in "sing").

column1: # P: intonation. Statements, questions, lists, and moving emphasis.

column3: Are you going home, or to the office?
We need eggs, milk, bread, and butter.
When I got home, the lights were off.
I said the *red* car, not the blue one.
Did you lock the door before you left?
The meeting is at three, isn't it?
Well, I suppose we could try again tomorrow.
My grandmother lived in a little yellow house near the river.
Nobody knew what had happened to the old lighthouse keeper.
That was the longest afternoon of my entire life.

column1: # S: the same ten sentences in each speaking style (record once per style).

column3: The train leaves at half past six in the morning.
I can't believe you finished the whole puzzle already.
Turn left at the bakery and keep walking until you see the bridge.
We should probably bring an umbrella, just in case.
Have you ever seen the ocean during a thunderstorm?
The library will be closed on Monday for repairs.
She opened the letter slowly and read it twice.
What a beautiful morning it is!
If you need anything at all, just let me know.
The results were better than anyone had expected.
